description: This file implements the ApplicationMaster for Spark on YARN, managing the lifecycle of Spark applications running on YARN, including registration, resource allocation, driver and executor management, and communication with the ResourceManager and Spark driver.

classes.name: ApplicationMaster
classes.description: Main class managing Spark application lifecycle on YARN, including registration, resource management, driver/executor handling, and communication with YARN ResourceManager and Spark driver.

classes.name: ApplicationMaster.ApplicationMaster
classes.description: Inner class implementing the core application master logic for Spark on YARN.

classes.name: ApplicationMaster.ApplicationMaster.ApplicationMaster
classes.description: Constructor initializing the ApplicationMaster with arguments, Spark configuration, and YARN configuration.

classes.name: ApplicationMaster.ApplicationMaster.AMEndpoint
classes.description: RpcEndpoint class for communication between ApplicationMaster and Spark driver.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the ApplicationMaster, initializes SparkConf, YarnConfiguration, and starts the master process.

methods.name: sparkContextInitialized
methods.description: Notifies ApplicationMaster that SparkContext has been initialized.

methods.name: getAttemptId
methods.description: Returns the ApplicationAttemptId of the current application.

methods.name: getHistoryServerAddress
methods.description: Constructs the URL for the Spark History Server for the application.
